subject.title: docs: add Third-party UIs section to documentation (deepclaw-ui)

question: Should official OpenClaw docs include a curated Third-party UIs page that lists DeepClaw UI as a community Gateway dashboard?
rationale: The change is documentation-only but introduces an official listing for an external UI, which is a curation and security-posture decision rather than a broken existing behavior.

options.title: Review the linked docs PR
options.body: Proceed with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89515 if maintainers want a curated third-party UI page with security guidance.

options.title: Keep listings outside official docs
options.body: Decline the official docs page and route community UI discovery to external channels or marketplace-style surfaces.

options.title: Ask for neutral criteria first
options.body: Require a vendor-neutral listing policy before naming specific external UIs in docs.

recommendation.title: Review the linked docs PR
recommendation.body: Proceed with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89515 if maintainers want a curated third-party UI page with security guidance.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter Steinberger is the best available routing candidate from the recent docs navigation history for a product/docs curation decision.
